full_description: Inspect the horizontal red block's initial position and choose the arm on its reachable side as the giver; grasp and lift a regular segment, rotate the block's long axis to world vertical in clear space, transfer a separate exposed segment to the opposite receiving arm, ensure the receiver has securely grasped it, then release the giver
schema: {A} denotes the red 3 by 3 by 20 centimeter block, {a} denotes the giver arm, and {b} denotes the receiver arm
preference: num of words should not exceed 15
seen: Lift {A}, turn it vertical, and pass it to the other arm.
Use {a} to raise {A} vertically and transfer it to {b}.
Grasp {A}, rotate it upright, then complete the handover.
Pick up {A}, present it vertically, and pass it across.
Raise {A} upright before transferring it to the opposite arm.
Turn the lifted {A} vertical, then hand it to {b}.
Use the reachable arm to lift, verticalize, and transfer {A}.
Pass {A} vertically from its nearer arm to the other arm.
Lift the red block, rotate it upright, and switch hands.
Keep {A} vertical while transferring it between the arms.
unseen: Pick {A}, make it vertical, and hand it over.
Transfer the upright red block to the opposite arm.
Lift {A} and rotate it vertical before switching arms.
Use one arm to raise {A} upright and pass it.
Hand the vertically held {A} to the other arm.
